1.en_consolidated_definition: The diploglosus plei is a reptile belonging to the family Euprepidae and was described by Stahl in his catalog number 69.

reference_definitions: . Reptil. (Diploglosus plei; Euprepes mabula spinolonotus, Wiegman). Stahl, Catalog. 69.
Nombre que en Ponce recibe la iguana.
Se oye decir lucia, de la iguana (así, . gr., por Ponce), con vocablo, por lo que parece, hispánico.
